tagline: Lebih dari Sekadar Fasilitas. Kampusmu, Terhubung.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

navy_primary.description: Deep Navy Blue used for Top Navigation, Hero section background, Admin Sidebar, and primary structural panels.

gold_accent.description: Gold / Vibrant Amber used for Primary CTA buttons, key badges, highlighting statistics, and interactive callouts.

sky_info.description: Light Blue / Sky used for informative chips, location pills, and soft highlight backgrounds.

layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons/inputs, rounded-full for badges/chips

header_nav.background: bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-md text-white border-b border-slate-800 sticky top-0 z-50

facility_card.badge_status: absolute top-3 right-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border backdrop-blur-md shadow-sm

wizard_stepper.container: flex items-center justify-between max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-8 relative
wizard_stepper.step_circle: w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm transition-all duration-300 z-10

wizard_stepper.upcoming_step: bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700

admin_dashboard.sidebar: w-64 bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 flex flex-col h-screen fixed left-0 top-0 border-r border-slate-800 z-40

admin_dashboard.data_table: w-full border-collapse text-sm text-left border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden

interactive_map_guidelines.custom_markers: Colored pin icons with category badges (Gedung = Gold, Lab = Indigo, Olahraga = Emerald, Aula = Rose)
interactive_map_guidelines.floating_sidebar: Filter by zone, purpose, and instant availability on map view
interactive_map_guidelines.marker_preview_card: Bottom floating card when pin clicked showing facility thumbnail, title, capacity, and 'Detail Fasilitas' button

motion_and_animations.page_transitions: Framer motion page fade & slight slide-up (opacity: [0, 1], y: [12, 0])
motion_and_animations.card_hover: Hover scale 1.02 with shadow elevation and smooth 250ms ease-out cubic bezier
motion_and_animations.stepper_progress: Smooth width transition on progress line with spring animation on active circle
motion_and_animations.toast_notifications: Sonner toasts sliding from top-right corner with status icons

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on all buttons, links, inputs, tables, calendar cells, and modal triggers
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large display headers and status chips

instructions_to_main_agent: Always build UI components in Javascript (.js / .jsx) as configured in the frontend.
Use dark navy blue (#0F172A) for navigation headers, hero backdrop, and admin sidebar.
Use warm gold/amber (#F59E0B) for primary actions, prominent CTAs, and key stats highlights.
Keep content card canvas clean and light with subtle borders (border-slate-200 / border-slate-800).
Ensure every interactive component has a data-testid attribute.
Use Sonner for toast notifications on form submission and WhatsApp redirects.
Render availability calendar with clear status indicators for Available, Internal Schedule, External Booking, and Maintenance.
